confidence_notes: Medium overall. Coffee and restaurant meal anchors come from several Italian and crowdsourced averages that broadly agree, though most are 2024-era figures and not July 2026 prices. Beer and wine are lower confidence: they rest on a restaurant price list with no stated location and one Sicilian bar review. The cocktail anchor is derived from aperitivo packages and the usual relationship of about 2x draft beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Palermo summer rates, not checked against live listings. EUR was converted at an assumed 1.12 USD per EUR, taken from a third-party cross rate. The FX observation was reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange rates page for 2026-10-15; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Palermo is priced against Italian national and Sicilian data. Coffee comes from the Assoutenti/Mimit survey (about EUR 1.87 for Palermo in 2024) and other sources (about EUR 1.80 to 1.83), rounded up to EUR 2.00 for 2026. Restaurant meals come from yearly-average and crowdsourced cost-of-living figures. Beer and wine use Italian restaurant menu prices and the local beer-to-wine relationship. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Southern Italian city in peak summer, benchmarked loosely against comparable Italian and Southern European cities.
